verdict.rationale: Unity's scripting manual says scripting lets you interact directly with the public Unity APIs for finer control and customization. Editor extensibility (custom inspectors, Editor Windows, Property Drawers) shows scripts reach beyond runtime into the editor. Beyond that the evidence is thin: missing for 10: naming of the primary scripting language, evidence of language productivity, evidence that the API is fully exposed rather than partially, any debugger support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
